snippet.title: MythTerra Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4992830/MythTerra/

The goblin tribes have descended from the wastelands, and only you can stop them. In this high-fantasy pixel art RTS, you must unite the fractured realms of humans, elves, and dwarves. Build your base, manage resources, and unleash powerful magic to defend your kingdom from the goblin horde.

🎨 Art
Character/Terrain pixel art by Pixel Frog: https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/

Magical Effects pixel art by unTied Games:
https://untiedgames.itch.io/

🖥️ My socials: 
https://x.com/Svarog_dev
https://www.instagram.com/svarog_dev


#rts #devlog #indiedev #godot
